parameters.content:
## 1 of 2 — when an order arrives

A store webhook posts here (Shopify, Etsy or Square — the parser
detects the source and reads the same facts out of each shape). In order:

1. the order is read and checked (Square custom orders wait for the
   deposit to land)
2. it is matched against the board — the same store order is never
   written twice
3. every line item must have a rule in PRODUCT_RULES before a shipping
   window can be promised
4. **the row is written first**, then the confirmation email goes out
   quoting the honest window

Everything you edit lives in the **config** node.

## Nothing is sent until you say so

`TEST_RUN = true` with a blank `TEST_EMAIL` (how it ships) writes the row
but sends no email. Open **STOP: preview...** to read exactly what the
customer would get.

With no sheet configured at all (BOARD_READY = false, how it ships) the
run stays in memory: **STOP: demo...** shows the row and the email.
